messages.subject: MSstats vs. SRMstats
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I've heard that some people prefer using SRMstats to MSstats, but I thought that MSstats was the latest version and retains all of the functionalities of SRMstats.  Is this true?  Are there any reasons to use SRMstats instead of MSstats?

thanks,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: MSstats vs. SRMstats
messages.body_plain:
Dear Alex,

We are not supporting SRMstats any more. MSstats, on the other hand, continuously evolves.  In the last year or so we fixed bugs and added functionality. Most importantly, MSstats 3.0 has big changes as compared to MSstats 2.0, and improves in both speed and accuracy. Before the end of the month we are planning a new release that will introduce additional features in term of robustness to outliers and treatment of missing values. I would like to encourage you to use MSstats.

Sincerely
Olga
